rationale: FX03 flagged cost_currency value U_USD as not USD, but the raw SOI schedule labels the valuation columns as Amortized Cost and Fair Value and shows dollar signs for those monetary columns. A representative flagged row, Hornetsecurity Holding GmbH, has amortized cost '$ 3,143' and fair value '$ 3,312 (EUR 3,049 )'; the schedule total also uses '$'. The source therefore supports USD-denominated valuation fields, so the warning is caused by treating the extractor token U_USD as non-USD rather than by a source data error.
